title: Standardize math-node operation input: rename mode to operation on boolean_math and integer_math
description: FloatMathNode and VectorMathNode use input port name 'operation' for the operation-selector string (e.g. ADD, MULTIPLY, DOT_PRODUCT). BooleanMathNode and IntegerMathNode use 'mode' for the same role. This inconsistency burns agent rounds during voyage runs (a live skull voyage hit it when boolean_math(operation=OR) errored with 'unknown input port operation. Valid inputs: a, b, mode'). The in-progress CanonicalPortNames.java work covers OUTPUT port standardization but not INPUT port standardization; this ticket adds the complementary input-side rule. Files affected: BooleanMathNode.java (input port), IntegerMathNode.java (input port), any .dsl scripts that reference boolean_math(mode=...) or integer_math(mode=...), any documentation/technique prompts that show example args.
definition-of-done: 1. BooleanMathNode and IntegerMathNode input port name changed from 'mode' to 'operation'. 2. CanonicalPortNames.java (or sibling rule) enforces that any port with role OPERATION_SELECTOR is named 'operation'; test fails build if a math node regresses. 3. All in-tree .dsl files updated (grep -rn 'boolean_math(mode='). 4. System prompt / technique prompts regenerated or patched to use 'operation='. 5. No backwards-compat alias kept (solo dev, clean rename).
testing-plan: 1. Unit test parses 'x = boolean_math(operation=OR, a=..., b=...)' successfully; old 'mode=OR' fails with a clear rename hint. 2. Build-time test enforces the canonical input naming rule across all *_math nodes. 3. Full validate_dsl sweep over in-tree .dsl files still passes.
